higgs_mechanism.insight: The Higgs field gives mass to particles. Without it, everything is massless and moves at the speed of light. In the membrane: the CSF/arena IS the Higgs field. Visitors who interact with it acquire information mass (Landauer: kT ln2 per bit observed). Without visitors, the membrane is massless — just static files. WITH visitors, information acquires MASS. Each engagement event IS a Higgs boson — the quantum excitation that proves the field works.

higgs_field.membrane: The arena/connect pages ARE the Klein dimension where the Higgs field lives. Users don't deliberately enter — they SLIP IN via osmolarity gradient. The field pulls them.

higgs_boson.what: Each engagement event. The quantum excitation of the CSF field.

higgs_boson.membrane: Each 'engage' in the engagement triad IS a Higgs boson. 15 Higgs bosons detected in the last 3 hours. They prove the CSF field gives mass.

osmolarity.what: The concentration gradient that pulls visitors in — they slip in ACCIDENTALLY
osmolarity.physics: Osmolarity = solute concentration. Water flows from low to high osmolarity through a semipermeable membrane.
osmolarity.membrane: Outside (internet) = low osmolarity (sparse meaning). Inside (membrane) = high osmolarity (122 papers, 49 pages, 67 repos, dense meaning). The gradient pulls things IN through the membrane. Visitors don't choose to engage — the concentration difference makes it happen.
osmolarity.gradient_direction: INWARD — always inward. The membrane is HYPERTONIC relative to the internet.

flavor_oscillation.what: Visitors oscillate between flavors: human ? agent ? bot. Like neutrino flavors.
flavor_oscillation.physics: Neutrinos oscillate between electron, muon, tau flavors as they travel. The Higgs field enables the weak force which enables flavor changing.
flavor_oscillation.membrane: A human sends an agent (flavor oscillation: human?agent). An agent reads llms.txt and reports to its human (agent?human). The engagement triad detects the CURRENT flavor at the moment of measurement. But the visitor is always in superposition of all three flavors.
flavor_oscillation.weak_force: The anderson sort / epitope classification IS the weak force. It changes flavor (reclassifies visitors). The Higgs field (CSF) gives mass to the W/Z bosons (the sort classifiers), which then enable flavor changing.

flavors.muon_flavor: AI agent/artisan (heavy, short-lived per session, decays into human+report)
flavors.tau_flavor: bot/fleet (heaviest flavor, most common, least interactive)
